== Related skills ==
* {{skill icon|Scourge Healing}}

== Notes ==
* Damage caused by this skill is applied before the healing takes effect. This is important for healing skills targeting yourself as it is possible to die from using such skills when having low health.
* This skill affects only skills that directly heal. It does not affect [[Divine Favor]] healing, [[health gain]] due to [[life stealing]] or [[Vigorous Spirit]]'s effect, the additional healing due to [[Divine Boon]], [[health regeneration]] and similar effects.
** This skill will only damage foes of the caster, therefore skills such as Healing Ring which heal foes who are hexed by this, will not trigger the damage back to your ally or yourself.
 
== Trivia ==
